thread.title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for February, 4th (AAPL, ABMD, AMGN, AZN, ETN, GOOGL, KMT, LSXMA, MDEVF, MLCO)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for February, 4th (AAPL, ABMD, AMGN, AZN, ETN, GOOGL, KMT, LSXMA, MDEVF, MLCO)
text:
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Sunday, February 4th: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its equal weight rating reiterated by analysts at KeyCorp. Get Apple Inc alerts: 
ABIOMED (NASDAQ:ABMD) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at BTIG Research. Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a $191.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “AMGN’s top-line continues to be uninspiring, but the bottom line will meaningfully benefit from a lower than expected tax rate (surprise, surprise) and a large, accelerated $10B share buyback. There are several moving pieces to consider heading into 2018 (which are apparent in management’s uncharacteristically wide guidance range), including timing/magnitude of legacy franchise erosion (e.g., Neulasta & Sensipar), trajectory of recent/upcoming launches (e.g., Kyprolis, Repatha, Aimovig), and the extent to which AMGN chooses to exercise its upsized share repurchase authorization (now ~$14B in total). While we continue to be keenly interested in potential for M&A (which AMGN continues to be constructive on) and the earlier stage pipeline, we maintain our Neutral rating pending evidence of sustainable near-/mid-term growth.””
AstraZeneca (NYSE:AZN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. 
Eaton (NYSE:ETN) was upgraded by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus from a hold rating to a buy rating. 
Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Aegis. They currently have a $1,350.00 target price on the stock. 
Kennametal (NYSE:KMT) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus. They currently have a $52.00 price target on the stock. 
Liberty Sirius XM Group (NASDAQ:LSXMA) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Macquarie. They currently have a $52.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We believe this very large and persistent discount will finally close as Liberty’s ownership approaches 80%, likely by 2H19 if not earlier via an accelerated dividend or buyback. Our TP of US$52 is based on applying a 5% discount while our TP on SIRI is US$6.75 (Fig 1). Impact First, a few data points emerged this month as well as from Sirius XM’s call: In Jan ’18 CEO Meyer renewed his contract through Dec ’18 while CFO Frear’s contract expires in May. On the Board side, Liberty-entity Live Nation CEO Michael Rapino was appointed to Sirius XM’s Board while Sirius XM CEO/CFO Meyer/Frear joined Pandora’s board. We believe these highlight shifting ownership dynamics and leave room for change (M&A, cross-collaboration, etc).”” 
Melco Intl Dev (OTCMKTS:MDEVF) was upgraded by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc from a neutral rating to a buy rating. 
Melco Resorts & Entertainment (NASDAQ:MLCO) was upgraded by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc from a neutral rating to a buy rating. 
Prothena (NASDAQ:PRTA) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. The firm currently has a $65.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Friday’s announcement that the CMO will resign her position may have created some disconcerting optics, but lacking any definitive details, we caution against over-interpreting the disclosure.”” 
Phillips 66 Partners (NYSE:PSXP) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus. Stifel Nicolaus currently has a $62.00 target price on the stock. 
Rhythm Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RYTM) was downgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a buy rating to a hold rating. 
Shutterfly (NASDAQ:SFLY) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Aegis. They currently have a $73.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We maintain our Buy rating and increase our price target on the stock to $73. We keep Shutterfly on our list (here) of four SMID Internet stocks that could deliver FANG-like shareholder returns this year.”” 
Textron (NYSE:TXT) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Jefferies Group LLC. Jefferies Group LLC currently has a $74.00 target price on the stock. 
Veritone (NASDAQ:VERI) was downgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a sell rating to a strong sell rating. 
Wells Fargo & Co (NYSE:WFC) was downgraded by analysts at Keefe, Bruyette & Woods from an outperform rating to a market perform rating.
